contributions.statement: Have the agent plan how each step will be verified together with the implementation plan, before writing code; joint program-and-proof planning beat implementation-only planning by 3.3-8.3 points and avoided full-restart repair loops.
contributions.evidence: §5.2 Table 3 ablation (Opus-4.7 only, single run): Plan-Seq vs P3 69.8/74.6, 44.8/48.1, 13.9/22.2; Appendix K attributes Seq cost to full-restart repairs. Lean 4 proofs, not tests.

reason: Lean-specific, but the ablation isolates 'plan the verification with the code' from planning alone, which supports a verification-plan section in spec templates; transfer from proofs to JUnit is untested.
